articles.title: Trump boasts, Infantino hits back and Belgium vow action as Balogun furore rages on
articles.summary: President Donald Trump says he asked FIFA boss Gianni Infantino to "review" Folarin Balogun's red card and World Cup ban, which has since been suspended, allowing the USA striker to play in the last-16 tie with Belgium.

articles.title: Spurs smash transfer record again to sign Tonali in £100m deal
